intent.raw_query: Nepal trekking Annapurna, $2000 solo, October 2026, 14 days

experiences.name: Annapurna Base Camp Trek
experiences.description: Embark on the iconic multi-day trek to Annapurna Base Camp at 4,130m. Trek through rhododendron forests, terraced fields, and glacial moraines while enjoying breathtaking views of Annapurna I, Machapuchare, and Hiunchuli peaks. The trail passes through traditional Gurung villages offering authentic cultural immersion alongside stunning Himalayan scenery.
experiences.location: Annapurna Sanctuary, Chhomrong to ABC route

experiences.name: Poon Hill Sunrise Hike
experiences.description: Rise before dawn and hike to Poon Hill viewpoint at 3,210m for one of Nepal's most spectacular sunrises. Watch golden light illuminate the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri mountain ranges in a panoramic 180-degree view. The relatively short but rewarding hike takes about 1.5 hours from Ghorepani and is considered one of the best sunrise viewpoints in the entire Himalayas.

experiences.name: Gurung Village Cultural Walk and Dal Bhat Experience
experiences.description: Explore the traditional Gurung and Magar villages along the Annapurna Circuit, visiting local homes, monasteries, and mani walls. Participate in a home-cooked Dal Bhat meal with a local family, learning about traditional Nepali cuisine including lentil soup, rice, seasonal vegetables, and pickles. This immersive cultural experience provides deep insight into the indigenous mountain communities of the Annapurna region.

experiences.name: Annapurna Conservation Area Nature Walk
experiences.description: Join a guided nature walk through the Annapurna Conservation Area, home to diverse flora and fauna including red pandas, Himalayan tahr, and over 400 bird species. Trek through dense rhododendron and oak forests, crossing suspension bridges over glacial rivers. A knowledgeable local naturalist guide will identify medicinal plants, wildlife tracks, and explain the unique high-altitude ecosystem of one of the world's most biodiverse protected areas.
experiences.location: Annapurna Conservation Area, Chomrong to Sinuwa trail

experiences.name: Thorong La High Pass Crossing
experiences.description: Challenge yourself with the legendary crossing of Thorong La Pass at 5,416m, the highest point of the Annapurna Circuit and one of the highest trekking passes in the world. Start before sunrise from Thorong Phedi, ascending through rocky alpine terrain with prayer flags marking the summit. Descend dramatically to the sacred pilgrimage town of Muktinath, rewarding yourself with views of the Tibetan plateau and a visit to the ancient Muktinath temple complex.
experiences.location: Thorong La Pass, Manang to Muktinath route

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Annapurna, Nepal
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery — flight arrives at 22:30, so no morning activities scheduled
day_by_day.afternoon: Rest and recovery — flight arrives at 22:30, so no afternoon activities scheduled
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu at 22:30. Clear immigration, collect baggage, and arrange a pre-booked budget taxi or shared shuttle to your accommodation. Check in to Aegean Bliss Resort, freshen up, and rest.

meals.breakfast: On the flight
meals.lunch: On the flight or at the airport
meals.dinner: Quick snack from a 24-hour airport kiosk or convenience store near accommodation upon arrival

day_by_day.notes: Pre-book an airport taxi in advance to avoid overpriced touts. Exchange a small amount of USD to NPR at the airport for initial expenses. Keep arrival night simple — just rest.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up and enjoy breakfast at the resort. Head to Pokhara lakeside (Phewa Lake) for an early morning walk along the Promenade. Take in views of the Annapurna range reflecting on the lake. Visit the Barahi Temple on a small island accessible by a short rowboat ride.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Pokhara Bazaar on foot — browse local trekking gear shops and stock up on budget essentials for your trek (snacks, sunscreen, trekking poles if needed). Visit the International Mountain Museum (entry ~NPR 300) to learn about Annapurna and Himalayan history.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll the Lakeside area at dusk. Watch the sunset over Phewa Lake from the lakeside promenade. Explore the local night market.

meals.breakfast: Dal Bhat at the resort or a nearby local teahouse (~NPR 200-300)
meals.lunch: Budget local restaurant in Pokhara Bazaar — try momos (dumplings) and chai (~NPR 200-250)
meals.dinner: Lakeside budget restaurant — try thukpa (noodle soup) or vegetable curry (~NPR 300-400)

day_by_day.notes: This is an acclimatization and preparation day. Pokhara sits at ~820m elevation. Pick up any last-minute trekking permits and TIMS card if not arranged in advance. Carry cash as ATMs may be limited on the trail.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning sunrise hike up to Sarangkot Hill (1,592m) — a 1.5-2 hour uphill walk from Pokhara. Witness a spectacular panoramic sunrise over the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges. This is one of the best free viewpoints in Nepal.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend back to Pokhara. Visit Devi's Fall (Patale Chhango) — a dramatic underground waterfall (~NPR 50 entry). Explore the adjacent Gupteshwor Mahadev Cave (~NPR 100 entry).
day_by_day.evening: Return to the lakeside. Arrange and confirm your trekking route logistics for the Annapurna Circuit or Poon Hill trek starting tomorrow. Pack your trekking bag.

meals.breakfast: Pack a light breakfast from the resort or grab local bread and chai before sunrise hike (~NPR 100-150)
meals.lunch: Local dal bhat at a Pokhara teahouse after descending Sarangkot (~NPR 250-300)
meals.dinner: Budget local restaurant near lakeside — try Nepali set meal (~NPR 350-450)

day_by_day.notes: Start the Sarangkot hike by 5:00 AM to catch sunrise. Wear warm layers as it can be cold at the top. Confirm TIMS card (NPR 2,000) and ACAP permit (NPR 3,000) are ready before trekking begins tomorrow.

day_by_day.morning: Take an early local bus or jeep from Pokhara to Nayapul (1-1.5 hours, ~NPR 200-300). Begin the Poon Hill Trek — hike from Nayapul to Tikhedhunga (1,540m), approximately 3-4 hours of moderate trekking through rhododendron forests and terraced farmland.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking from Tikhedhunga to Ulleri (1,960m) — a challenging but rewarding 1.5-2 hour climb up steep stone steps with over 3,000 steps. Arrive and check into a budget teahouse.
day_by_day.evening: Rest at Ulleri teahouse. Enjoy the mountain views from the village. Interact with fellow trekkers and locals.

meals.breakfast: Dal Bhat at a Nayapul teahouse before starting the trek (~NPR 250)
meals.lunch: Simple teahouse lunch at Tikhedhunga — fried rice or noodles (~NPR 300-350)
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat dinner at Ulleri teahouse (included or ~NPR 400-500)

day_by_day.notes: Teahouse accommodation in Ulleri costs approximately NPR 200-400 per night (sometimes free if you eat meals there). Stay hydrated and pace yourself on the Ulleri stone steps — they are steep but manageable.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning hike from Ulleri to Ghorepani (2,860m) — approximately 3-4 hours through dense rhododendron forest. Arrive at Ghorepani and check into a budget teahouse. The village sits in a stunning mountain bowl.
day_by_day.afternoon: Rest and acclimatize at Ghorepani. Take a short exploratory walk around the village. Visit the local viewpoints near the village for afternoon mountain views of Dhaulagiri and Annapurna South.
day_by_day.evening: Prepare for the 4:30 AM Poon Hill sunrise hike tomorrow. Set an alarm, pack a light daypack, and get an early night.

meals.breakfast: Porridge or eggs at Ulleri teahouse (~NPR 200-300)
meals.lunch: Teahouse lunch en route or at Ghorepani — veg noodle soup (~NPR 300-400)
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat at Ghorepani teahouse (~NPR 400-500)

day_by_day.notes: October is peak trekking season — Ghorepani can be busy. Book teahouse accommodation early in the day. Temperatures drop significantly at night at this altitude — use your sleeping bag liner.

day_by_day.morning: Wake at 4:00 AM and hike 45 minutes to Poon Hill viewpoint (3,210m). Watch a breathtaking sunrise over the Annapurna range, Dhaulagiri, Machhapuchhre (Fishtail), and Nilgiri. One of Nepal's most iconic viewpoints — completely worth the early start.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend back to Ghorepani for breakfast, then continue trekking to Tadapani (2,590m) — approximately 4-5 hours through rhododendron and oak forests with excellent wildlife spotting opportunities (Himalayan birds, langur monkeys).
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Tadapani. Settle into a budget teahouse. Enjoy spectacular sunset views of Annapurna South and Hiunchuli from the village.

meals.breakfast: Hot tea at Poon Hill summit (~NPR 100), then full breakfast at Ghorepani teahouse (~NPR 250-300)
meals.lunch: Packed snacks or quick teahouse stop en route to Tadapani (~NPR 200-300)
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat at Tadapani teahouse (~NPR 400-500)

day_by_day.notes: Poon Hill entry fee is NPR 100. Bring a torch/headlamp for the dark morning hike. The trail to Tadapani has some steep sections — trekking poles are helpful.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Tadapani to Chhomrong (2,170m) — approximately 4-5 hours. The trail descends steeply through forests before climbing back up to the large Gurung village of Chhomrong, the gateway to the Annapurna Sanctuary.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Chhomrong village — a charming Gurung settlement with terraced fields and excellent mountain views. Visit the local viewpoints overlooking the Modi Khola gorge and Annapurna South.
day_by_day.evening: Relax at a Chhomrong teahouse. Enjoy the best views of Annapurna South and Hiunchuli at sunset. Rest your legs for tomorrow.

meals.breakfast: Eggs on toast or porridge at Tadapani teahouse (~NPR 250)
meals.lunch: Teahouse lunch en route — garlic soup and bread (~NPR 300-350)
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat at Chhomrong teahouse (~NPR 400-500)

day_by_day.notes: Chhomrong has better facilities than most trail villages — you can recharge devices and buy snacks here. This is the last major supply point before the Annapurna Base Camp trail. Stock up on snacks.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery day at Chhomrong. Take a leisurely morning walk through the village terraces and interact with local Gurung families. Visit the small Chhomrong monastery for a peaceful cultural experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Optional short hike to a nearby ridge for panoramic views of the Annapurna massif. Alternatively, relax at the teahouse, journal, read, and enjoy the mountain scenery.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset watching from Chhomrong viewpoint. Prepare gear and pack for the next two days of trekking toward the Annapurna Base Camp direction or alternate route back.

meals.breakfast: Pancakes with honey at teahouse (~NPR 200-250)
meals.lunch: Veg fried rice at a local teahouse (~NPR 300)
meals.dinner: Nepali thali (dal bhat) at teahouse (~NPR 400-500)

day_by_day.notes: This rest day is important for acclimatization and muscle recovery. October weather in Chhomrong is generally clear and cool — ideal for mountain photography. Altitude here is manageable at 2,170m.

day_by_day.morning: Begin return trek from Chhomrong toward Jhinu Danda (1,780m) — approximately 2-3 hours downhill. Jhinu Danda is famous for its natural hot springs by the Modi Khola river.
day_by_day.afternoon: Soak in the Jhinu Danda natural hot springs (~NPR 200 entry) — a perfect reward for tired trekking legs. Spend 1-2 hours relaxing in the steaming natural pools surrounded by forest and river sounds.
day_by_day.evening: Trek down to New Bridge (1,340m) — approximately 1.5 hours. Check into a budget teahouse by the river. Enjoy the sound of the Modi Khola rushing by.

meals.breakfast: Oatmeal or eggs at Chhomrong teahouse (~NPR 250)
meals.lunch: Snacks and tea at Jhinu Danda near the hot springs (~NPR 200-250)
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat at New Bridge teahouse (~NPR 350-450)

day_by_day.notes: The hot springs are a highlight of this trek — don't miss them. The path from Chhomrong to Jhinu involves a steep descent on stone steps. Take care on wet or mossy sections.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from New Bridge to Landruk (1,565m) — approximately 3-4 hours uphill through beautiful forest. Landruk is a traditional Gurung village with stunning views of Machhapuchhre (Fishtail Mountain) and Annapurna South.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Landruk village. Walk through the traditional stone-paved lanes, observe local Gurung culture, and visit the village viewpoints. Take photos of the magnificent Fishtail Mountain backdrop.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset over the Annapurna range from Landruk — one of the most photogenic spots on the trail. Rest at a budget teahouse.

meals.breakfast: Bread and jam with tea at New Bridge teahouse (~NPR 150-200)
meals.lunch: Teahouse lunch at Landruk — veg chow mein (~NPR 300-350)
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat at Landruk teahouse (~NPR 400)

day_by_day.notes: Landruk has several budget teahouses with good mountain views. October evenings are cool at this elevation — bring a warm layer for sunset watching.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Landruk to Dhampus (1,650m) — approximately 3-4 hours. Dhampus is one of the most beautiful viewpoint villages in the Annapurna foothills, offering sweeping 180-degree views of the entire Annapurna range.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Dhampus village and its famous viewpoints. Walk the ridge trail above the village for unobstructed panoramas. Spot the Annapurna I (8,091m), Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, and Machhapuchhre.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the golden hour sunset paint the Annapurna peaks from Dhampus ridge. This is considered one of the finest sunset viewpoints in all of Nepal. Overnight at a budget teahouse.

meals.breakfast: Porridge with banana at Landruk teahouse (~NPR 200-250)
meals.lunch: Simple dal soup and rice at a trail teahouse (~NPR 250-300)
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat at Dhampus teahouse (~NPR 400-450)

day_by_day.notes: Dhampus is accessible by road from Pokhara, so it can be slightly busier than other trail villages. Budget teahouses here are clean and comfortable. This is your last full night on the trail.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise from Dhampus viewpoint — set your alarm for 5:30 AM for one last spectacular Himalayan sunrise. After breakfast, begin the descent from Dhampus to Phedi (1,130m) — approximately 2 hours downhill through forest.
day_by_day.afternoon: From Phedi, take a local taxi or bus back to Pokhara (~NPR 300-500, 45 minutes). Arrive back in Pokhara, check back into Aegean Bliss Resort. Freshen up, do laundry, and rest your legs.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate completing your Annapurna trek with a lakeside stroll. Enjoy a well-deserved dinner at a slightly nicer lakeside restaurant as a treat.

meals.breakfast: Eggs and toast at Dhampus teahouse (~NPR 250-300)
meals.lunch: Quick local snack in Phedi or on return to Pokhara (~NPR 200)
meals.dinner: Celebratory dinner at a lakeside Pokhara restaurant — try Nepali-Newari cuisine (~NPR 500-700)

day_by_day.notes: You have successfully completed approximately 8 days of trekking in the Annapurna region! Take care of your feet — soak them and treat any blisters. Rehydrate well tonight.

day_by_day.morning: Relaxed morning in Pokhara. Visit the World Peace Pagoda (Shanti Stupa) — hike up or take a boat across Phewa Lake and hike 30 minutes to the gleaming white Buddhist stupa with panoramic 360-degree views of Pokhara and the Annapurna range.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to Pokhara lakeside. Browse the Tibetan refugee market for budget souvenirs and handicrafts. Visit the Seti River George viewpoint — a dramatic narrow gorge where the milky white Seti River disappears underground.
day_by_day.evening: Final evening in Pokhara. Enjoy a lakeside sunset, browse local shops for last-minute gifts, and have a relaxed dinner. Reflect on your incredible 14-day Annapurna adventure.

meals.breakfast: Full Nepali breakfast at resort or local cafe — eggs, toast, fresh juice (~NPR 300-400)
meals.lunch: Budget lakeside cafe — try yak cheese sandwich or veggie burger (~NPR 350-450)
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat farewell dinner at a highly-rated local restaurant (~NPR 400-500)

day_by_day.notes: World Peace Pagoda boat ride costs approximately NPR 200 return. Tibetan market items are negotiable — bargain politely for best prices. Pack your bags tonight for the journey home tomorrow.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in Annapurna region. Enjoy a leisurely breakfast with one last view of the Annapurna peaks. Take a short final walk along Phewa Lake shoreline to soak in the beauty of Pokhara.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort. Arrange transport to Pokhara Airport (if flying to Kathmandu) or bus station. Take a scenic 6-7 hour tourist bus back to Kathmandu (~NPR 600-800) or a 25-minute flight (~NPR 5,000-7,000 budget airline).
day_by_day.evening: Arrive in Kathmandu. Transfer to Thamel area for any final night stay if needed, or proceed to Tribhuvan International Airport for onward flight. Browse Thamel for any last-minute Nepal souvenirs.

meals.breakfast: Final Nepali breakfast at resort — dal bhat or pancakes (~NPR 250-300)
meals.lunch: Packed lunch or teahouse stop en route to Kathmandu (~NPR 200-300)
meals.dinner: Budget Thamel restaurant or airport dining (~NPR 400-600)

day_by_day.notes: Budget approximately NPR 600-800 for the tourist bus to Kathmandu. Book bus tickets a day in advance from Pokhara bus station. Keep your passport and important documents accessible for airport check-in. Total estimated budget for 14 days (excluding flights): USD 400-600 including accommodation, meals, permits, and transport.

trip_options.title: Classic Annapurna, Nepal Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery — flight arrives at 22:30, so no morning activities scheduled
day_by_day.afternoon: Rest and recovery — flight arrives at 22:30, so no afternoon activities scheduled
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu at 22:30. Clear immigration, collect luggage, and meet your pre-arranged transfer. Drive or take a taxi to your accommodation near the Annapurna region (overnight stay in Pokhara or resort area). Check in to Aegean Bliss Resort and get settled.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable (in transit)
meals.lunch: Not applicable (in transit)
meals.dinner: Light snack or late-night dal bhat at a local dhaba near the airport or resort if available upon arrival

day_by_day.notes: Flight arrives late at night. Pre-book airport transfer in advance. Keep first night light — hydrate well and rest to acclimatize to the altitude and time zone. Pokhara sits at ~820m elevation.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely breakfast at the resort. Spend the morning orienting yourself — explore the resort grounds, take in views of the Annapurna massif, and visit Phewa Lake (a short walk or ride from most Pokhara-area resorts). Rent a rowboat and paddle to the Tal Barahi Temple on the lake island.
day_by_day.afternoon: Stroll along the Lakeside (Baidam) promenade. Browse local trekking gear shops and pick up any supplies needed for upcoming hikes. Visit the International Mountain Museum to learn about Himalayan peaks, climbing history, and local culture — a perfect primer for your trekking days ahead.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the sunset over Phewa Lake and the Annapurna range from a lakeside café. Explore the Lakeside bazaar for souvenirs and local crafts.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort — enjoy eggs, toast, fresh fruit, and Nepali tea
meals.lunch: Momos (dumplings) and thukpa (noodle soup) at a mid-range Lakeside restaurant such as Boomerang Restaurant or similar
meals.dinner: Dal bhat set meal at a local Nepali restaurant on Lakeside — budget NPR 400–700 per person

day_by_day.notes: October is peak trekking season in Nepal — expect clear skies and excellent mountain views. Confirm your trekking permits (ACAP and TIMS card) at the Annapurna Conservation Area office in Pokhara today if not pre-arranged.

day_by_day.morning: Early rise for sunrise views from Sarangkot Hill (accessible by taxi or a 1.5-hour uphill hike from Lakeside). On clear October mornings, you'll see Annapurna I, Annapurna South, Machhapuchhre (Fishtail), and Dhaulagiri glowing in golden light. Return to the resort by mid-morning.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the World Peace Pagoda (Shanti Stupa) — hike up via the southern trail from Lakeside (~45 minutes) or take a boat across Phewa Lake and hike up from the other side. Enjoy panoramic views of Pokhara valley and the Himalayas. Explore the Gupteshwor Mahadev Cave and Davis Falls nearby.
day_by_day.evening: Relax at the resort and prepare trekking gear for the days ahead. Light stretching or yoga if available at the resort.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast at resort or pack snacks for Sarangkot — banana, boiled eggs, and Nepali tea
meals.lunch: Fresh trout grilled at a lakeside restaurant — Pokhara is famous for its lake fish
meals.dinner: Thakali cuisine set meal (a regional specialty from the Thak Khola valley) at a mid-range restaurant — try Thakali Kitchen or similar

day_by_day.notes: Sarangkot is best visited before 7:00 AM for clearest mountain views before clouds roll in. Carry a light jacket as mornings are cool in October (~10–15°C at altitude).

day_by_day.morning: Begin the Annapurna Sanctuary Trek (or Poon Hill circuit depending on fitness level). Take a taxi or local bus to Nayapul (1.5 hours from Pokhara). Start trekking through terraced fields and rhododendron forests toward Birethanti and onward to Tikhedhunga. Trek duration: approximately 4–5 hours of walking.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking from Tikhedhunga upward along stone-stepped trails to Ulleri (1,960m). This is a challenging but rewarding climb with sweeping valley views. Arrive at a teahouse in Ulleri and check in.
day_by_day.evening: Rest at the teahouse, warm up with butter tea or hot lemon, and socialize with fellow trekkers. Enjoy the peaceful mountain village atmosphere.

meals.breakfast: Porridge, eggs, and toast at the resort before departure
meals.lunch: Dal bhat or noodle soup at a teahouse in Tikhedhunga
meals.dinner: Teahouse dinner in Ulleri — dal bhat, vegetable curry, or pasta (NPR 400–600)

day_by_day.notes: Carry your ACAP permit and TIMS card — checkpoints begin at Birethanti. Drink at least 3 liters of water daily. The stone staircase to Ulleri has over 3,000 steps — take it slow and steady. October weather is ideal: dry, clear, and mild.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning trek from Ulleri through oak and rhododendron forests to Ghorepani (2,860m). The trail winds through dense forest with occasional mountain glimpses. Trek duration: approximately 4–5 hours. Arrive and check in to a mid-range teahouse.
day_by_day.afternoon: Rest and acclimatize at Ghorepani. Take a short exploratory walk around the village, visit the small local gompa (Buddhist monastery), and enjoy the surrounding scenery. Optional: short hike to the ridge above town for preview mountain views.
day_by_day.evening: Warm up by the teahouse fire with fellow trekkers. Watch the alpenglow on Dhaulagiri and Annapurna South as the sun sets. Prepare for the pre-dawn Poon Hill hike tomorrow.

meals.breakfast: Teahouse breakfast in Ulleri — porridge, eggs, and hot tea
meals.lunch: Teahouse lunch on the trail — fried rice or noodles
meals.dinner: Dal bhat dinner at Ghorepani teahouse — hearty and filling for tomorrow's early start

day_by_day.notes: Set your alarm for 4:30–5:00 AM for tomorrow's Poon Hill sunrise hike. Ghorepani can be cold at night in October (0–5°C) — ensure you have a warm sleeping bag or request extra blankets. Stay well-hydrated.

day_by_day.morning: Pre-dawn hike to Poon Hill (3,210m) — a 45-minute uphill walk from Ghorepani. Witness one of the most iconic sunrises in the Himalayas, with a 360-degree panorama including Annapurna I (8,091m), Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, Machhapuchhre, Dhaulagiri (8,167m), and dozens of other peaks. Return to Ghorepani for breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Trek from Ghorepani through rhododendron and magnolia forests to Tadapani (2,630m). The trail offers continuous mountain views and diverse birdlife — October is excellent for birdwatching. Trek duration: approximately 4 hours.
day_by_day.evening: Settle into a teahouse in Tadapani. Enjoy the quieter, less-crowded atmosphere compared to Ghorepani. Stargazing opportunity on clear October nights.

meals.breakfast: Hot tea and snacks at Poon Hill viewpoint, then full breakfast (eggs, toast, porridge) back at Ghorepani teahouse
meals.lunch: Packed lunch or teahouse stop on the trail to Tadapani
meals.dinner: Vegetable curry, rice, and lentil soup at Tadapani teahouse

day_by_day.notes: Poon Hill entry requires a small fee (NPR 100). Bring a headlamp and warm layers for the pre-dawn hike. The trail to Tadapani can be muddy in sections — trekking poles recommended. Keep snacks handy for energy on the trail.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Tadapani to Chomrong (2,170m) — a scenic descent and ascent through forests with views of Machhapuchhre (Fishtail Mountain) becoming increasingly dramatic. Trek duration: approximately 4–5 hours. Chomrong is the last major settlement before the Annapurna Sanctuary.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Chomrong village — a charming Gurung community with stone-paved streets, traditional houses, and friendly locals. Visit the small Chomrong Danda viewpoint for spectacular close-up views of Annapurna South and Hiunchuli.
day_by_day.evening: Rest and recharge at a comfortable mid-range teahouse. This is a good opportunity to assess fitness and gear before the higher-altitude section of the trek.

meals.breakfast: Porridge and eggs at Tadapani teahouse
meals.lunch: Noodle soup or fried rice at a teahouse on the trail
meals.dinner: Dal bhat at Chomrong — many teahouses here offer good quality meals; try the apple pie for dessert, a trekking trail classic

day_by_day.notes: Chomrong has the last reliable ATM and phone signal before the sanctuary. Withdraw sufficient cash (NPR) for the remaining trek days. Teahouse prices increase as you go higher — budget NPR 500–800 per meal above this point.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Chomrong through Sinuwa and Bamboo (2,335m) into the lower Modi Khola gorge. The trail enters dense bamboo and rhododendron forest — watch for Himalayan wildlife including langur monkeys and colorful pheasants. Trek duration to Dovan: approximately 5–6 hours total.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue through Himalaya (2,920m) to Dovan (2,600m) or push on to Deurali (3,230m) if energy permits. The gorge narrows dramatically and the landscape becomes increasingly alpine and spectacular.
day_by_day.evening: Rest at a teahouse in Dovan or Deurali. The temperature drops noticeably at this elevation — layer up. Enjoy the dramatic gorge scenery as clouds drift through the valley.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at Chomrong before departure
meals.lunch: Hot noodles or dal bhat at a teahouse in Bamboo or Himalaya
meals.dinner: Hearty meal at Dovan or Deurali teahouse — pasta, fried rice, or dal bhat

day_by_day.notes: The trail through the gorge can be slippery — take care on wet rocks. Altitude increases rapidly from here — watch for signs of altitude sickness (headache, nausea, dizziness). Ascend slowly and do not push beyond your comfort level. Acclimatization is critical.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Deurali to Machhapuchhre Base Camp (MBC) at 3,700m — a stunning open valley with towering walls of ice and rock. The trail crosses moraines and glacial streams. Trek duration: approximately 2–3 hours. Take time to absorb the dramatic scenery.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue from MBC to Annapurna Base Camp (ABC) at 4,130m — the crown jewel of the trek. The final approach opens into a vast glacial amphitheater surrounded by some of the world's highest peaks: Annapurna I, Annapurna South, Gangapurna, Glacier Dome, and Machhapuchhre. Trek duration from MBC: approximately 2 hours.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at ABC and check in to a teahouse. Watch the sunset paint the surrounding peaks in shades of orange, pink, and purple — an unforgettable experience. Acclimatize carefully and rest.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at Deurali before the ascent
meals.lunch: Light snack at Machhapuchhre Base Camp — energy bars, chocolate, hot tea
meals.dinner: Dal bhat or pasta at ABC teahouse — meals are simple but warming at this altitude

day_by_day.notes: ABC at 4,130m is high enough to cause altitude sickness. Move slowly, breathe deeply, and stay well-hydrated (4+ liters of water daily). Do not ascend if you feel unwell — descending is always the safest option. October skies are typically clear, making this one of the best months to visit ABC.

day_by_day.morning: Wake before sunrise for the magical golden hour at ABC — the Annapurna massif illuminated by the first rays of dawn is one of the most awe-inspiring sights in the Himalayas. Spend the morning exploring the base camp area, taking photographs, and soaking in the extraordinary mountain environment.
day_by_day.afternoon: Begin descent from ABC back to Bamboo (2,335m) via MBC, Deurali, Dovan, and Himalaya. Descending is faster — approximately 5–6 hours of trekking. The lower altitude will help with recovery and energy.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Bamboo teahouse. Celebrate reaching ABC with fellow trekkers. The lower altitude means warmer temperatures and a more comfortable night's sleep.

meals.breakfast: Hot porridge and tea at ABC before descent
meals.lunch: Teahouse meal at Himalaya or Dovan on the way down
meals.dinner: Dal bhat and vegetable curry at Bamboo teahouse

day_by_day.notes: Descend carefully — knees take significant strain on the long downhill sections. Trekking poles are very helpful. Pace yourself and take breaks. The descent from ABC to Bamboo in one day is long but very manageable for most trekkers.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Bamboo back to Chomrong — retrace the trail through Sinuwa with fresh perspectives on the landscape. Trek duration: approximately 3–4 hours. Enjoy the increasingly lush vegetation as you descend.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue from Chomrong down to Jhinu Danda (1,780m), a small village famous for its natural hot springs on the banks of the Modi Khola river. Soak your tired trekking muscles in the thermal pools — a well-deserved reward after days of high-altitude trekking.
day_by_day.evening: Overnight at a teahouse in Jhinu Danda. Enjoy the warm evening air at lower elevation and the sound of the river below.

meals.breakfast: Eggs and toast at Bamboo teahouse
meals.lunch: Noodle soup or fried rice at Chomrong
meals.dinner: Fresh vegetable curry and rice at Jhinu Danda teahouse

day_by_day.notes: The Jhinu Danda hot springs are a 20-minute walk downhill from the village — entry fee approximately NPR 200–300. The springs are open until evening. This is one of the most enjoyable stops on the entire circuit — do not skip it!

day_by_day.morning: Final morning soak in the hot springs if desired, then trek from Jhinu Danda to Nayapul via Landruk and Birethanti. The trail passes through traditional Gurung villages with terraced fields and beautiful river valley scenery. Trek duration: approximately 4–5 hours.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Nayapul and take a taxi or local bus back to Pokhara (approximately 1.5 hours). Return to Aegean Bliss Resort — enjoy a hot shower, fresh clothes, and the comfort of a proper bed after days on the trail.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate the completion of your Annapurna trek with a special dinner in Pokhara. Enjoy the lakeside atmosphere and reflect on an extraordinary adventure.

meals.breakfast: Teahouse breakfast at Jhinu Danda before departure
meals.lunch: Quick meal at Birethanti or Nayapul before the drive
meals.dinner: Celebratory dinner at a mid-range Lakeside restaurant — try Nepali or continental cuisine with a lakeside view; budget NPR 800–1,500 per person

day_by_day.notes: Return your trekking permits if required at the Birethanti checkpoint. Arrange taxi from Nayapul in advance or negotiate at the bus park. Treat yourself to a proper dinner tonight — you've earned it after 9 days of trekking!

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery day in Pokhara. Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely resort breakfast. Optional: gentle lakeside walk or yoga session. Visit a local massage parlor for a traditional Nepali or Ayurvedic massage to soothe tired muscles (NPR 800–1,500 per hour).
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the Old Bazaar area of Pokhara — a more authentic and less touristy part of the city with traditional Newari architecture, local markets, and the Bindhyabasini Temple. Visit the Pokhara Regional Museum for insight into local culture and history.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset from a Lakeside café terrace. Browse the Lakeside market for last-minute souvenirs — Thanka paintings, pashmina scarves, handmade jewelry, and trekking memorabilia.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast — enjoy every amenity after days of teahouse food
meals.lunch: Café lunch at a Lakeside spot — try a wood-fired pizza or fresh salad for a change of pace
meals.dinner: Newari cuisine dinner — try yomari (sweet dumplings), bara (lentil pancakes), and chiura (beaten rice) at a local Newari restaurant

day_by_day.notes: Use this day to do laundry, reorganize your pack, and rest your body. Many Lakeside shops offer next-day laundry service at reasonable rates. Back up your trek photos and videos. Consider writing a journal entry or review of your experience.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in the Annapurna region. Early morning visit to the Devi's Fall (Patale Chhango) and the adjacent Gupteshwor Cave if not visited earlier — a fascinating natural waterfall that disappears underground. Return to resort for checkout.
day_by_day.afternoon: Drive or fly from Pokhara to Kathmandu (25-minute scenic mountain flight or 6–7 hour road journey — mountain flight highly recommended for stunning aerial views of the Himalayas). Arrive in Kathmandu and explore the Thamel district — Nepal's backpacker hub with countless shops, cafés, and cultural sites.
day_by_day.evening: Final evening in Nepal. Visit Thamel for last-minute shopping — carpets, singing bowls, spices, and handcrafted goods. Enjoy a farewell dinner in Kathmandu before any onward travel.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — savor the Annapurna views one last time
meals.lunch: Light meal at Pokhara airport or on arrival in Kathmandu
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner in Kathmandu's Thamel district — try Krishnarpan restaurant for an authentic multi-course Nepali feast or a mid-range option like OR2K or Yin Yang Restaurant

day_by_day.notes: Book the Pokhara-Kathmandu mountain flight in advance — seats sell out quickly in October peak season. The flight offers breathtaking views of the Annapurna and Manaslu ranges. If flying out of Kathmandu, allow at least 3 hours before departure for check-in. Carry all trekking permits and receipts for your records.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Annapurna, Nepal Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

experiences.name: Poon Hill Sunrise Hike
experiences.description: Rise before dawn and hike to Poon Hill viewpoint at 3,210m for one of Nepal's most spectacular sunrises. Watch golden light illuminate the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri mountain ranges in a panoramic 180-degree view. The relatively short but rewarding hike takes about 1.5 hours from Ghorepani and is considered one of the best sunrise viewpoints in the entire Himalayas.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport at 22:30 — No morning activities scheduled due to late-night arrival.
day_by_day.afternoon: No afternoon activities — flight in transit.
day_by_day.evening: Late-night arrival at 22:30. Private luxury transfer arranged from Kathmandu airport to your hotel. A dedicated concierge meets you at the gate with a welcome garland and refreshments. Check-in at Aegean Bliss Resort, Annapurna. A warm welcome drink and light midnight snack await in your suite.

meals.breakfast: In-flight or airport lounge dining
meals.lunch: In-flight or airport lounge dining
meals.dinner: Late-night welcome snack platter and herbal teas prepared by the resort upon arrival

day_by_day.notes: Ensure all luggage is collected and immigration is cleared smoothly. The private transfer driver will be holding a placard with your name. Rest is the priority tonight — no early morning wake-up call scheduled for Day 2.

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely late morning wake-up and recovery breakfast at the resort's signature restaurant. Orientation tour of the Aegean Bliss Resort grounds with your personal butler. Explore the resort's spa facilities, infinity pool views of the Annapurna range, and garden terraces. Light yoga session on the private deck if desired.
day_by_day.afternoon: Gentle introductory nature walk through the surrounding village trails near the resort. A guided 2–3 hour easy hike through terraced rice fields and rhododendron forests with a certified local naturalist guide. Visit a nearby traditional Gurung village to experience local culture and architecture. Return to resort for a relaxing afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails on the resort's panoramic terrace with sweeping Annapurna Himalayan views. Indulge in a 60-minute traditional Ayurvedic welcome massage at the resort spa. Private candlelit dinner under the stars on your suite's private balcony or the resort's exclusive outdoor dining area.

meals.breakfast: Lavish à la carte breakfast at the resort restaurant — eggs Benedict, fresh Himalayan honey, seasonal fruits, artisan breads, and Nepali butter tea or specialty coffee
meals.lunch: Light gourmet lunch at the resort's poolside lounge — grilled sandwiches, fresh salads, and freshly squeezed juices
meals.dinner: Private candlelit dinner featuring a curated Nepali tasting menu — dal bhat with premium ingredients, Himalayan trout, and artisan desserts paired with imported wines

day_by_day.notes: This is an acclimatization and rest day. Altitude awareness begins here — stay hydrated, avoid alcohol in excess, and inform the concierge of any discomfort. Trekking gear check and briefing with your guide can be arranged in the afternoon.

day_by_day.morning: Early breakfast followed by a guided moderate hike to Dhampus viewpoint (1,650m). This 3–4 hour scenic hike offers stunning panoramic views of Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, Machhapuchhre (Fishtail Mountain), and Dhaulagiri. A certified guide leads the way through dense forests and charming villages.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend via a different scenic trail back to the resort or nearby Phedi. Enjoy a gourmet picnic lunch prepared by the resort chef at a scenic overlook point. Return to the resort for a relaxing afternoon dip in the heated infinity pool with Himalayan views.
day_by_day.evening: Visit the resort's wellness center for a 90-minute deep-tissue mountain recovery massage. Enjoy pre-dinner drinks at the resort's lounge bar. Dinner at the resort's fine dining restaurant featuring international cuisine with Nepali influences.

meals.breakfast: Early power breakfast — granola parfait, smoked salmon bagels, fresh juices, and premium Nepali coffee
meals.lunch: Gourmet picnic basket prepared by the resort chef — artisan sandwiches, charcuterie, fresh fruit, and sparkling water served at a mountain viewpoint
meals.dinner: Four-course dinner at the resort's signature restaurant — amuse-bouche, Himalayan herb soup, pan-seared duck breast, and dark chocolate fondant with Himalayan salt

day_by_day.notes: Wear sturdy trekking boots and carry a light rain jacket as October afternoons can bring brief cloud cover. Trekking poles recommended. Sunscreen and a hat are essential at elevated viewpoints.

day_by_day.morning: Depart early for the iconic Poon Hill Sunrise Hike experience — private vehicle transfer to Nayapul or Tikhedhunga trailhead. Begin the ascent toward Ulleri and Ghorepani with your expert guide and porter. The forested trail through giant rhododendron trees is magnificent in October golden light.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Ghorepani (2,860m) and check into a premium pre-booked teahouse lodge or luxury tented camp. Rest and acclimatize. Afternoon exploration of Ghorepani village and interaction with local Magar and Gurung communities. Warm herbal tea and local snacks provided.
day_by_day.evening: Cozy fireside dinner at the lodge with mountain views. Stargazing session from the lodge terrace — October skies are exceptionally clear, offering views of the Milky Way and Himalayan silhouettes. Early bedtime in preparation for the pre-dawn Poon Hill hike.

meals.breakfast: Hearty early breakfast at the resort before departure — oatmeal, eggs, toast, and energy bars for the trail
meals.lunch: Trail lunch at a scenic rest stop — packed gourmet lunch box with sandwiches, energy snacks, dried fruits, and thermos of hot soup
meals.dinner: Warm lodge dinner featuring Nepali staples elevated with premium ingredients — dal bhat, vegetable curry, Tibetan bread, and hot ginger honey tea

day_by_day.notes: This is an overnight stay away from the resort. Pack a small overnight bag with warm layers, headlamp, and personal essentials. The resort will store your main luggage. Porter services are included in the premium package. Altitude increases significantly — drink plenty of water.

day_by_day.morning: Wake at 04:30 for the legendary Poon Hill Sunrise Hike. Ascend 45–60 minutes by torchlight to Poon Hill viewpoint at 3,210m. Witness one of Nepal's most spectacular sunrises — a golden panorama of over 20 Himalayan peaks including Dhaulagiri (8,167m), Annapurna I (8,091m), Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, and the iconic Machhapuchhre. Return to Ghorepani lodge for a warm breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend via the scenic Tadapani trail through pristine rhododendron and oak forests. Enjoy the lush, bird-rich forest trail with your naturalist guide. Private vehicle pickup at the trail endpoint for a comfortable return transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort. Arrive at resort mid-afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Reward yourself with a luxurious 2-hour spa treatment — choice of hot stone massage, Himalayan salt scrub, or aromatherapy session. Champagne and canapés on the resort terrace to celebrate the Poon Hill achievement. Elegant dinner at the resort.

meals.breakfast: Pre-hike energy snack at 04:30 (energy bars, hot tea) followed by a full warm breakfast at the lodge after sunrise — eggs, porridge, pancakes, and hot beverages
meals.lunch: Packed trail lunch or a stop at a scenic teahouse along the descent for fresh noodle soup and local bread
meals.dinner: Celebratory dinner at the resort's finest dining venue — six-course tasting menu with wine pairing, featuring Himalayan trout, lamb, and artisan desserts

day_by_day.notes: The pre-dawn hike to Poon Hill is the highlight of the entire trip. Dress in warm layers (temperatures can drop to 0–5°C at 3,210m in October). Bring your camera and extra batteries — the sunrise views are extraordinary. A thermos of hot tea is provided by the guide.

day_by_day.morning: Full rest and recovery morning at the resort. Indulge in a slow, luxurious breakfast with no schedule. Optional gentle resort yoga class led by a certified Himalayan yoga instructor on the outdoor deck with mountain views. Visit the resort library for books on Nepali culture, Himalayan history, and nature.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private guided nature photography walk through the surrounding landscapes with a professional photographer guide. Learn to capture the dramatic Annapurna peaks, local village life, and Himalayan flora. Return to resort for afternoon tea service on the terrace.
day_by_day.evening: Private cooking class with the resort's head chef — learn to prepare authentic Nepali dishes including momos (dumplings), dal bhat, and sel roti (traditional rice bread). Enjoy the meal you prepared for dinner in the resort's private dining room.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely gourmet breakfast — eggs your way, smoked salmon, avocado toast, seasonal fruit platter, fresh juices, and Nepali specialty teas
meals.lunch: Light afternoon tea service — finger sandwiches, Nepali pastries, scones with clotted cream, and premium loose-leaf teas
meals.dinner: Dishes prepared during the cooking class, served in the private dining room with curated wine or local craft beverages

day_by_day.notes: This is a scheduled rest day to recover from the Poon Hill trek. Gentle activities only. Hydration and nutrition are key. The photography walk is suitable for all fitness levels and camera types — even smartphones produce stunning results in October's clear light.

day_by_day.morning: Private guided day hike to Sarangkot viewpoint (1,592m) — one of the finest panoramic viewpoints in the Annapurna region. Depart early for the 2–3 hour scenic ascent. Enjoy 360-degree views of the Annapurna and Lamjung Himalayan ranges, Pokhara Valley, and Phewa Lake below.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend to Pokhara lakeside for a premium afternoon experience. Private luxury boat ride on Phewa Lake with views of Machhapuchhre reflected in the water. Visit the Tal Barahi Temple on the island in the lake. Explore the Pokhara Lakeside area with your guide. Private vehicle return to the resort.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset drinks at a premium Pokhara lakeside rooftop restaurant before returning to the resort. Optional visit to Pokhara's finest restaurants for dinner, or return to the resort for a private lakeside-inspired dinner experience.

meals.breakfast: Early energizing breakfast at the resort — granola, eggs, fresh fruit, and energy-boosting Nepali ginger tea
meals.lunch: Premium lunch at a renowned Pokhara lakeside restaurant — international and Nepali fusion cuisine with lake views
meals.dinner: Dinner at one of Pokhara's finest dining establishments or back at the resort — grilled meats, fresh Himalayan trout, and artisan desserts

day_by_day.notes: October is peak season in Pokhara — the skies are clear and the mountain reflections on Phewa Lake are at their most stunning. Carry sunscreen and a light jacket. The boat ride on Phewa Lake is a must-do. Confirm the private boat booking with the concierge the evening before.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise helicopter tour over the Annapurna range — a premium exclusive experience. Depart from Pokhara airport for a 60–90 minute scenic helicopter flight over Annapurna Base Camp (4,130m), the Annapurna Sanctuary, Machhapuchhre, and the surrounding glaciers. Land at a high-altitude point for a champagne toast with Himalayan views.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to resort by mid-morning. Enjoy a leisurely afternoon at the resort's infinity pool and wellness facilities. Optional 60-minute reflexology or foot massage treatment at the spa. Afternoon nature journaling session on your private balcony.
day_by_day.evening: Private cultural evening at the resort — a curated performance of traditional Gurung and Magar folk music and dance by local artists. Enjoy the performance over a special Nepali feast dinner set up in the resort's garden.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-flight breakfast at the resort — toast, yogurt, fresh fruit, and green tea (avoid heavy meals before the helicopter flight)
meals.lunch: Post-flight brunch at the resort — smoked salmon eggs Benedict, fresh pastries, tropical fruits, and sparkling beverages
meals.dinner: Traditional Nepali feast dinner in the resort garden — an elaborate spread of dal bhat, various curries, tandoori dishes, momos, and traditional sweets accompanied by local music performance

day_by_day.notes: The helicopter tour is weather-dependent — October offers the best flying conditions in Nepal with clear skies and minimal cloud cover. The tour operator will confirm weather clearance the morning of the flight. This is the most exclusive experience of the trip — cameras and binoculars are highly recommended.

day_by_day.morning: Guided trek to the Australian Base Camp (ABC Annapurna) region — a full-day premium trekking experience. Depart early by private vehicle to the Annapurna Conservation Area trailhead. Begin the ascent through dense subtropical forests, terraced farmlands, and traditional villages toward the Modi Khola river valley.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking through the dramatic gorge landscape with towering Himalayan peaks on all sides. Gourmet picnic lunch at a scenic riverside location. Continue to Chomrong village (2,170m), one of the most scenic villages in the Annapurna region with stunning views of Annapurna South and Hiunchuli. Return trek or private vehicle pickup for resort return.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive back at resort by early evening. Relaxing hot stone bath drawn by your butler with Himalayan mineral salts and essential oils. Light but nourishing dinner at the resort to replenish after the long day of trekking.

meals.breakfast: High-energy early breakfast at the resort — oatmeal with Himalayan honey, scrambled eggs, whole grain toast, and herbal tea
meals.lunch: Gourmet riverside picnic — artisan wraps, fresh salads, protein-rich snacks, energy bars, and hot soup in a thermos
meals.dinner: Nourishing recovery dinner at the resort — grilled salmon, quinoa salad, roasted vegetables, and herbal tisane

day_by_day.notes: This is the most physically demanding full-day trek of the itinerary. Wear well-broken-in trekking boots and carry trekking poles. The route passes through the Annapurna Conservation Area — entrance permits are arranged by your guide. October weather is ideal with clear skies and comfortable temperatures.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and rejuvenation morning. Full 90-minute premium spa treatment — choose from Himalayan hot stone therapy, deep tissue sports massage, or traditional Ayurvedic Abhyanga massage. Followed by a meditation session in the resort's dedicated meditation pavilion with Himalayan views.
day_by_day.afternoon: Guided birdwatching excursion in the Annapurna foothills — October is an excellent month for Himalayan bird species including Himalayan Monal (Nepal's national bird), eagles, and various pheasants. Expert ornithologist guide leads a 3-hour gentle walk through forest trails near the resort.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset wine tasting session on the resort terrace — curated selection of Himalayan wines, international varieties, and local craft beverages paired with artisan cheese and charcuterie boards. Stargazing session with a telescope provided by the resort.

meals.breakfast: Relaxed gourmet breakfast — eggs Florentine, fresh fruit bowl, artisan breads, and a selection of premium teas and coffees
meals.lunch: Light poolside lunch — fresh salads, grilled fish tacos, fresh juices, and coconut water
meals.dinner: Intimate dinner for two at the resort's private dining cave or garden gazebo — five-course tasting menu with wine pairing

day_by_day.notes: Binoculars are provided for the birdwatching excursion. Wear muted, natural colors to avoid disturbing wildlife. The Himalayan Monal is most active in the early morning — if you wish to maximize sightings, consider an early 06:30 departure for the birdwatching walk.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Mustang region border area — private vehicle journey north toward the ancient Kali Gandaki Gorge, the world's deepest gorge, flanked by Dhaulagiri and Annapurna. Stop at Tatopani (1,190m) for a soak in the famous natural hot springs — a perfect therapeutic experience for trekkers' muscles.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue to Marpha village — a beautifully preserved Thakali village famous for its apple orchards and apple brandy. Visit the apple orchard estate for a private tasting of Marpha apple products — fresh apples, apple cider, apple jam, and apple brandy. Explore the charming whitewashed village lanes. Return journey to resort.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive back at resort in the evening. Relaxed evening at the resort's lounge bar with cocktails. Dinner at the resort featuring Thakali cuisine inspired by today's cultural journey.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the resort — continental spread with energy-boosting items for the long day trip
meals.lunch: Premium lunch at a renowned Thakali restaurant in Tatopani or Marpha — Thakali dal bhat, buckwheat pancakes, apple products, and local butter tea
meals.dinner: Thakali-inspired dinner at the resort — Thakali set meal with premium ingredients, accompanied by Marpha apple cider or wine

day_by_day.notes: The drive to the Kali Gandaki Gorge region is long but extraordinarily scenic. Depart by 07:00 to maximize time at each stop. The Tatopani hot springs are a highlight — bring a swimsuit. The Marpha apple brandy tasting is a unique cultural experience — purchase bottles as souvenirs from the resort shop.

day_by_day.morning: Premium mountain biking experience through the Annapurna foothills — guided downhill mountain biking on scenic trails through villages, forests, and terraced farmlands. High-quality mountain bikes and safety gear provided. Suitable for intermediate riders. The route offers spectacular views and cultural encounters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Post-biking recovery at the resort spa with a 60-minute sports massage. Alternatively, enjoy a leisurely afternoon at the resort pool. Optional visit to a local Nepali art gallery or handicraft workshop in the nearby town to purchase premium souvenirs — thangka paintings, pashmina shawls, and handmade jewelry.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell cocktail hour at the resort bar — premium cocktails and mocktails crafted with local Himalayan herbs and ingredients. Followed by a special chef's table dinner experience — dine in the kitchen with the head chef for an exclusive behind-the-scenes culinary experience.

meals.breakfast: High-energy breakfast for biking — protein-rich eggs, whole grain toast, Greek yogurt, banana, and energy drinks
meals.lunch: Gourmet post-biking lunch at a scenic viewpoint café or resort — grilled chicken salad, pasta, fresh juices, and electrolyte drinks
meals.dinner: Exclusive chef's table dinner — a bespoke multi-course meal designed personally by the head chef, with premium ingredients and wine pairing

day_by_day.notes: Mountain biking trails are graded for intermediate riders. Beginners can opt for a gentler route or substitute with a guided e-bike tour. Helmets and protective gear are mandatory and provided. The chef's table dinner must be booked at least 48 hours in advance — confirm with the concierge today.

day_by_day.morning: Final full-day premium trekking experience — guided hike to Landruk village (1,565m) through the beautiful Modi Khola valley with spectacular close-up views of Machhapuchhre (Fishtail Mountain) and Annapurna South. The trail passes through traditional Gurung villages with terraced fields and rhododendron forests.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Landruk for a cultural village homestay lunch experience — dine with a local Gurung family in their traditional home, prepared with organic produce from their garden. Interact with the family and learn about Gurung traditions, culture, and daily life. Descend and return to resort by private vehicle.
day_by_day.evening: Final evening celebration at the resort — premium farewell dinner on the rooftop or garden terrace with panoramic Himalayan views. Toast to an extraordinary Annapurna journey with champagne. Packing assistance provided by your butler for tomorrow's departure.

meals.breakfast: Final trekking breakfast — hearty eggs, toast, granola, fresh fruit, and specialty Nepali coffee
meals.lunch: Authentic Gurung family homestay lunch — home-cooked dal bhat, local vegetables, pickles, and traditional butter tea in a genuine village home
meals.dinner: Grand farewell dinner at the resort — premium seven-course tasting menu featuring the finest Nepali and international cuisine, with champagne and wine pairing

day_by_day.notes: The Gurung homestay lunch is a deeply authentic cultural experience — bring small gifts for the host family such as chocolates or stationery. Photography is welcome but always ask permission first. This is the final full trekking day — pace yourself and savor every moment of the trail.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise viewing from the resort terrace with hot Nepali tea and pastries — a quiet, reflective moment to absorb the last views of the Annapurna Himalayan range. Leisurely late breakfast at the resort. Final spa treatment or pool session if time permits before checkout.
day_by_day.afternoon: Resort checkout with full butler assistance. Farewell gifts from the resort — curated Nepali gift hamper including Himalayan tea, local honey, handmade crafts, and a personalized trip photo book. Private luxury transfer departs for Kathmandu or Pokhara airport for onward flight. Airport lounge access arranged for premium departure experience.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Nepal. Carry the memories of the Annapurna Himalayan adventure — the sunrise over Poon Hill, the helicopter flight over the glaciers, the cultural encounters, and the luxury of the Aegean Bliss Resort.

meals.breakfast: Final leisurely gourmet breakfast at the resort — a special farewell spread with all your favorites from the past two weeks, including fresh pastries, eggs, fruits, and premium beverages
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort or airport lounge before departure
meals.dinner: In-flight dining or airport lounge dinner

day_by_day.notes: Ensure all trekking permits, receipts, and personal items are collected before checkout. The resort concierge will assist with any last-minute purchases or arrangements. Allow ample time for the transfer to the airport — October is peak season and traffic can be heavy. Confirm flight details and check-in requirements with your airline.
